bullets.text: At Thiruvallur North Chennai Thermal Power Station, a boiler tube leak has disrupted 600 megawatt power generation.
The office should monitor Adambakkam MRTS station remaining shut seven months after extension opens over platform train gap.
At Kanagam Housing Board colony, residents protest because officials frequently pressure them to vacate homes they purchased.
Chennai has developed into an important IT and IT enabled services market with major technology clusters along OMR and Taramani.
In Pallikaranai, climate action group Aram Thinai is launching its second natural farmers market following a successful year in T Nagar.
Tiruvallur Collector Kavitha and Avadi Corporation Commissioner Saranya inspected dengue prevention measures in Avadi Corporation limits.
In Thiruvallur district Poondi union Othappai Primary Agricultural Cooperative Credit Society, joint registrar Palani Jayasree inspected crop loan waiver work.
The office should watch the Purattasi festival celebrations at the Mathuravedu Venugopalaswamy temple in Thiruvallur.
Tamil Nadu ration shops are implementing a new system to replace fingerprint scanning with face scanning for immediate product distribution.
Coimbatore currently hosts over 75 global capability centers and studies show this number will approach 200 by 2032.
Apple removed offline messaging app Bitchat from the India App Store following a MeitY demand under Section 69A.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Chennai on October 11 to inaugurate the IITM Maestro music centre at IIT Madras.
